--------------------------------------------------------------------

As of yesterday the FAIR Connect website is no longer functional, which means you can't use it to search for FSRs or FIPs anymore.

However, the [FAIR Implementation Space on nanodash](https://w3id.org/spaces/FAIR-Implementation-Space) serves as a machine-actionable alternative, allowing you to look up FSRs and FIPs all the same.
